title: Nuxe strengthens sales and marketing leadership to drive global growth
summary: Following the appointment of Christine Delfaut Sara as CEO, Nuxe is continuing to strengthen its organization with three strategic appointments. Already present in more than 60 countries, the French pioneer of natural skin and body care products aims to give fresh momentum to its growth ambitions in both domestic and international markets. title: L'Oreal USA settles suit with four plaintiffs over hair straightening products
summary: L'Oreal has reached a settlement with four women who sued the US branch of the French cosmetics giant claiming that a hair straightening product caused their cancer. Danielle Ward Mason, an attorney for the plaintiffs, announced the agreement reached on Monday, November 16, but did not disclose the amount of the settlement, which came as the case was going to trial in Chicago. The suit is one of a number filed against the company and other manufacturers of chemical hair relaxer products,... - Industry buzz / North America

title: Euromonitor identifies five consumer trends set to shape 2027
summary: Trust, transparency, reliability and tangible benefits are becoming increasingly important as consumers reassess their relationships with brands. Euromonitor International's latest report highlights five behavioural shifts with implications for the beauty industry. Consumers are becoming more selective about the brands they trust, more cautious about their spending and increasingly demanding when it comes to the value they receive. summary: The case housing the 24 beauty treats — including fragrances, makeup, travel-size products and accessories — is designed as a collectible disco ball, which was developed by Pure Trade.
